home.subtitle: Pick a vehicle → browse accessories → build a combo → export a PDF quote. Fitment defaults to needs verification.
home.disclaimer: Unverified fitment never claims compatibility. Contact details are sent only with your consent when quote submission is configured.

vehicle.title: Select your vehicle
vehicle.emptyBrands: No brands in the catalog yet.
vehicle.emptyTrims: No trim/version for the selected year. Pick another year or contact the store.

recommend.title: Accessory recommendations
recommend.needVehicle: Select a vehicle first for contextual suggestions.
recommend.addedToast: Added to combo — open the Combo tab

combo.title: Your combo
combo.empty: No products yet. Add some from Recommendations.
combo.unverifiedWarn: This combo includes items that need fitment verification — review carefully before ordering.
combo.duplicateWarn: This combo has multiple products in the same function ({categories}). Keep both or remove extras.
combo.conflictBody: You are adding “{incoming}” while the combo already has “{existing}” (same {category} group).

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.consent: I agree to send my contact details and notes so the store can follow up on this quote. Sent only when submission is configured — not stored as a fake browser save.
quote.consentRequired: Consent is required before sending contact details or notes.
quote.errorNotConfigured: Quote submission is not configured (QUOTE_WEBHOOK_URL missing). Request was not sent — contact the store or try again after configuration.
quote.errorFailed: Quote request failed. Please try again or contact the store.
quote.errorInvalid: Invalid request (empty combo or missing data).
quote.notConfiguredBanner: Quote submission is not ready in this environment. You can still download the PDF; contact the store for a formal quote.

chat.title: AI advisory
chat.placeholder: Ask about dashcam, pricing, or fitment…
chat.hint: Rule-based answers, no paid API calls. Never claims compatibility unless verified.

admin.title: Product admin
admin.sampleMode: Admin mode — edits persist to local JSON, not a production DB.
admin.roleNote: Auth.js + RBAC architecture (admin/editor). Production needs a real IdP.
admin.unauthorized: Sign in with admin or editor role required.
admin.fitmentHint: Status always defaults to Needs verification. Choose Verified only after technician confirmation.

fitment.disclaimer: Items marked needs verification have not been confirmed to fit this vehicle. Technician confirmation required before ordering.

pdf.title: Accessory quote
pdf.disclaimerPrice: Estimated pricing; tax, shipping, and extras not included.
pdf.disclaimerFitment: Accessories are not verified for this vehicle — a technician must check before install/order.
pdf.disclaimerContract: This quote is not a contract; technical confirmation required before order.
pdf.contact: KietAuto — contact the store to confirm quote and installation

fitmentNotes.hondaWireless: Adapter verified across many Honda models.
fitmentNotes.teslaNoHeadUnit: Tesla uses OEM screen — standard head-unit swap not applicable.
fitmentNotes.teslaNoCarplay: Tesla does not support OEM CarPlay.
fitmentNotes.rav4LiftgateXle: Power liftgate Pro verified on RAV4 XLE 2024.

catalog.unavailable: Catalog could not be refreshed. Reload this page before continuing.
catalog.itemUnavailable: This item is no longer available. Remove it before creating a quote.
catalog.quoteUnavailable: Could not create a current quote. Check the catalog and remove unavailable items in your combo.
